mostWorthwhile.text: Making the stellar nursery brought the chapter's transformations together and made the inheritance of material by future worlds tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making Light felt like a detour: it was the only offered move, and its connection to the remnant was not yet clear.

surprise.text: The explanation that the explosion both scatters elements made in the star and creates some more sharpened my understanding.

arbitrary.text: Light turning the expanding remnant into a nebula felt somewhat arbitrary; it was unclear whether light was revealing the nebula or creating it.

continue.text: Yes. The nursery provides an appealing hook for seeing how stellar material becomes rocky worlds, although I would want the connections to stay clearer than the Light step.
